title: Failure-First Evaluation Tree and Outcome Taxonomy
scopeLimits: Illustrates how DC2SC evaluates coordination outcomes, treating 'Do Not Aggregate' and 'Constraint Rejection' as first-class successes.
limitations: Conceptual decision tree; does not track live platform transactions.

accessibility.altText: A decision tree contrasting naive transaction metrics with DC2SC failure-first evaluation criteria where non-aggregation is a valid result.
accessibility.textEquivalent: Decision tree: Evaluates constraint satisfaction, outside option superiority, and zero-penalty exit. An orderly 'Do Not Aggregate' is classified as an informative research success.
